messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High error rate detected for enterprise tenant 'Empyrean' in us-west-2. Symptoms: 5xx spike, connection timeouts to emp-dedicated-usw2, ~60% of requests failing. Auto-retries increasing latency. Paging on-call.

mira (oncall): I'm on-call, taking lead. Lina, can you post current alert summary? :point_down:

samir (sre): alert summary: 5xx rate jumped at 02:11 UTC, spike peaked ~02:13, sustained. Backend telemetry shows connection resets between edge and emp-dedicated-usw2. CPU on pool nodes normal, but we see increased socket errors. Suspect network flakiness in us-west-2 AZ cluster.

jess (eng-runtime): adding runtime context: KV cache and ongoing KV streaming to that dedicated pool. If we drain blindly we may lose warm cache and cause higher latencies. Recommend warm failover to us-west-1 (emp-dedicated-usw1) which currently has warm capacity 80% idle.

mira (oncall): plan suggestion: 1) Notify customer Empyrean. 2) Start controlled traffic shift (10% -> 50% -> 100%) to emp-dedicated-usw1 using weighted DNS via route53 low TTL. 3) Drain connections from emp-dedicated-usw2 after shift. 4) Monitor error rate and latency. Agree? @ana please confirm customer comms.

ana (solutions): pinged Empyrean primary contact (empirean-oncall) via their dedicated channel and email. They've acknowledged and requested minimal disruption window. They asked for a short heads-up before final cutover. I'll keep them updated.

empirean-oncall (customer): Confirmed. We approve staged shift. Keep us posted at each step.

samir (sre): executing step 1: creating DNS weight change. Command:
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z3EXAMPLE --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.empyrean.example","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"usw1-weight","Weight":10,"Region":"us-west-1","TTL":30,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"34.201.12.45"}]}}]}'
```
Applying 10% traffic to emp-dedicated-usw1 now.

mira (oncall): starting realtime monitors: traces, per-route 5xx, token cost spikes, connection resets. Alert thresholds temporarily lowered for this run. Samir keep me posted.

samir (sre): route53 change propagated. Initial traffic to usw1 at ~12%. Error rate on Empyrean dropped from 60% -> 42% in 2m.

jess (eng-runtime): kick off cache-warm sync job to emp-dedicated-usw1 to reduce cold starts. Command: `redwoodctl jobs run cache-sync --tenant empyrean --target-pool emp-dedicated-usw1` ETA ~7m.

ana (solutions): Empyrean says they see ~partial improvement. They asked for an estimate to reach full switch. Told them ~30-45m including validation and final TTL churn.

samir (sre): increasing weight to 50% now.

mira (oncall): observed metrics: 5xx now 18%, p95 latency stable. Any signs of new errors from usw1? @jess

jess (eng-runtime): minor transient 429s on a single node in usw1 (rate limits due to initial burst). We've throttled a retry policy for Empyrean route to smooth inflight. p95 latency ok.

samir (sre): pushing to 90% weight. Route53 change:
```
# ups weight to 90
```
Propagation in progress.

empirean-oncall (customer): FYI we're monitoring our end, internal logs show requests responding from new region fine. No user-impact currently reported.

mira (oncall): once we hit >=90% and stable for 5m, we'll do final cutover (100%) and drain emp-dedicated-usw2. Who will run drain? Samir?

samir (sre): I'll run drain sequence: `redwoodctl drain --tenant empyrean --pool emp-dedicated-usw2 --grace 300` which signals runtime to stop accepting new sessions and finish inflight requests. Starting after 5m stable window.

jess (eng-runtime): note: draining will evict KV prefixes from nodes; we've ensured cache-sync completed earlier. Post-drain, we should run `redwoodctl health verify --tenant empyrean --pool emp-dedicated-usw1`.

samir (sre): weight at 90% seen by edge, 5xx at 6% now. Holding for 6m to ensure stability.

mira (oncall): good. Ana, customer comms update please.

ana (solutions): Notified Empyrean: 'Traffic now routed to us-west-1 (90%). We're waiting 5-10m then we'll cut final 100% and drain old pool. No user-facing impact expected.' They replied :thumbsup: and asked to confirm when drain begins.

samir (sre): initiating final 100% switch now. Route53 TTL 30s so final churn expected <2m.

jess (eng-runtime): seeing final churn. p95 steady. Inflight connections dropping on old pool as expected.

samir (sre): issuing drain command on emp-dedicated-usw2:
```
redwoodctl drain --tenant empyrean --pool emp-dedicated-usw2 --grace 300
```
Draining started at 02:48 UTC.

incident-bot: Note: Handoff reminder - post-incident owner: samir (sre) for remediation and initial RCA. Oncall rotation next in 6 hours.

mira (oncall): drain progressing. Active sessions on usw2 down from 230 -> 18 over 4m. No errors seen on the new pool. emp-dedicated-usw2 will be put in maintenance once drained.

ana (solutions): Empyrean confirms all internal tests green. They requested logs for the window; I've scheduled an export and shared secure link.

samir (sre): drain complete at 02:56 UTC. emp-dedicated-usw2 in maintenance, traffic fully on emp-dedicated-usw1. Closing alert thresholds and marking incident mitigated. Will keep thread open for any follow-ups.

mira (oncall): great job team. Next steps: Samir to own postmortem, include network vendor logs for us-west-2, timeline, and decisions. Ana to consolidate customer comms. Jess to add cache-warm metrics to the RCA. I'll file incident ticket and tag for urgent RCA review.

empirean-oncall (customer): Thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick response and the staged approach. We'll wait for postmortem.

jess (eng-runtime): I'll collect KV cache metrics + cache-sync job logs and drop them in the ticket.

samir (sre): creating incident ticket: INC-2026-4123. Assigning to team: eng-sre, eng-runtime, solutions. ETA for draft RCA 48h.

mira (oncall): closing pager but keeping thread open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
